title: How many students per programme?
instructions:
## The question

The dean wants a table of **programme** and **number of students**, but only for programmes with **more than two** students, with the largest programme first.

The database has three tables: **students** (id, name, programme, level, hometown), **courses** (code, title, credits, lecturer) and **enrolments** (student_id, course_code, semester, mark). Marks can be NULL when a result is not yet in. Use the Tables panel to peek at the data.

## Do this

1. Group the students by programme and count them: `COUNT(*)`.
2. Keep only groups with more than two students. A condition on a group goes in `HAVING`, not `WHERE`.
3. Sort by the count, largest first.

Name the count column `students` with `AS`.

config.schema:
CREATE TABLE students (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  programme TEXT NOT NULL,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hometown TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE courses (
  code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  credits INTEGER NOT NULL,
  lecturer TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE enrolments (
  student_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),
  course_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(code),
  semester TEXT NOT NULL,
  mark INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (student_id, course_code, semester)
);

`HAVING COUNT(*) > 2` filters the groups after counting.
`ORDER BY students DESC` puts the biggest programme first.
